title: Microsoft Powered Security Operations Webinar
summary: Optimize your Microsoft security investments with Xerox IT Solutions and Lumifi. Explore Defender, Sentinel, MDR and modern security operations.
body_markdown:
## Many organizations own powerful Microsoft security capabilities but struggle to operationalize them effectively.


In this session, Lumifi will demonstrate how organizations can extend and enhance Microsoft security investments through managed detection and response, continuous monitoring, and security operations expertise. Attendees will gain practical insight into how Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Sentinel, identity security, and threat monitoring work together to improve visibility, accelerate response, and strengthen overall cybersecurity posture.


### The Microsoft-Powered Security Operations Center featuring Lumifi October 20, 2026 at 11:00 AM CST


60-Minute Live Session + Q&A


#### What you'll learn


-


How Microsoft Defender and Sentinel work together to improve threat detection and response.


-


Common security capabilities organizations already own but may not be fully utilizing.


-


What a modern managed detection and response (MDR) model looks like in practice.


-


How continuous monitoring helps identify and contain threats before they become incidents.


-


Ways Lumifi extends and operationalizes Microsoft security investments to improve protection and visibility.


-


Key considerations when evaluating a Microsoft-centric security operations strategy.


Register now
